files.findings.md: The narrative deliverable. Read this first — it carries the caveats without which the confidence table invites exactly the wrong reading.
files.dataset_stats.json: Per-state and corpus-wide descriptive statistics: standards, realized hierarchy levels, distinct ancestors, age-band coverage, description coverage, standard_id collisions, and the golden annotation counts.
files.confidence_distribution.json: The re-measured confidence distribution on both paths, by level, by state, by prompt band, and joined to the human false-positive verdicts; plus the cross-run separation probe and the Medium-claim adjudication.

headline_results.the_result_to_lead_with: The confidence score is uninformative, and that is the finding. It takes 7 distinct values in [0.85, 0.97], never once enters the band its own prompt reserves for a guess, and the state with the best-evidenced detection in the corpus (KY: recall 1.000, code 1.000, verified precision 1.000, detection-exhaustive golden) is the state carrying the LOWEST scores. This is the evidence that gating on confidence would be wrong — which is what the pipeline already does not do (guardrail 2).

medium_claim_adjudication.claim_1_85_90_pct_at_0.95: REPRODUCES — 236/263 indicators = 0.8973, identical on both paths. Cite the measurement, never the article.
medium_claim_adjudication.claim_2_low_tail_is_tables_footnotes_odd: REFUTED — 4 of 6 states have NO sub-0.95 indicator; the tail is essentially all of Kentucky, where all 26 indicators score below the line. The score moves per DOCUMENT, not per hard passage.
medium_claim_adjudication.claim_3_a_0.70_review_gate: DEAD TWICE OVER — no such gate exists in the live code (guardrail 2), and zero of 379 recorded elements (and zero across 966 elements of repeats) score below 0.70, so it would have been inert if it did.

the_hallucination_threshold_trap.observation: The single confirmed invented element (NV SS.CI.PK3) scores 0.85 and is the single lowest-scoring element in the corpus. Across 14 same-configuration direct-path runs (966 elements) the ONLY element below 0.90 is that one, so the separation is not an artifact of one draw.
why_it_must_not_be_promoted: There is exactly ONE distinct invented element in the audited corpus. One positive case cannot establish a false-negative rate.
The prompt's own boundary is 0.80 and catches nothing; a cut at 0.90 is fitted after the fact to that single case.
The score is blind to the corpus's other non-verbatim category: all 39 real_split_title rows — real titles broken by multi-column interleaving — score at or above 0.95.
the_hallucination_threshold_trap.required_framing: Report it as an observation and state in the same breath why it cannot be promoted. Presenting it as a working hallucination detector would be a false claim in a permanently-archived paper.

two_paths_measured.why: The detector eval runs the direct path, production runs the batched one, and they do not converge (CLAUDE.md, 'batched vs direct'). Recorded side by side rather than pooled.
two_paths_measured.dataset_stats_use: BATCHED — the dataset is what production emits.
two_paths_measured.confidence_verdict_join_uses: DIRECT — the only path the false-positive audit covers.
two_paths_measured.batched_path_caveat: Biased UPWARD by construction: detector._merge_duplicate keeps max(keep.confidence, other.confidence). A direct-vs-batched difference in this distribution is an artifact of merging, not a statement about the model.
two_paths_measured.observed: direct 379 elements / 7 distinct values; batched 390 / 5. Indicators at 0.95+ are 236/263 on both.

detector_docstring_is_stale.what: detector.detect_structure's numbered docstring (detector.py:1514-1524) carries THREE defects, found by a sweep of both frozen files on 2026-08-23: (1) it names 'Claude Sonnet 4.5' twice, at lines 1516 and 1520, when detection runs on Opus 4.6; (2) line 1522 claims a step that does not exist — 'Flags low-confidence elements for review'; (3) it OMITS Pass-1 depth-map inference entirely, although detect_structure calls infer_depth_map(blocks) before chunk classification.
detector_docstring_is_stale.why_it_matters: Defect 2 is precisely the false claim guardrail 2 exists to catch, sitting in the source file a reader verifying that guardrail would open first. Defect 3 is the substantive one: the depth-map pass is the paper's central method claim, and the docstring of the function implementing it credits a step that does not exist while missing the one that does.
detector_docstring_is_stale.parser_swept_clean: parser.py carries no stale model name and no needs_review language — the only parser.py hits for those terms are in the gitignored infra/cdk/cdk.out.deploy-dev/ artifact copy, not the live file. Its queue item is an ADDITION (pre-normalization code logging so validator._validate_code_shape rejections can be localized), not a correction.
detector_docstring_is_stale.why_it_was_not_fixed_here: eval_common.code_version_hash hashes the raw bytes of detector.py and parser.py, so editing even a docstring changes 288c64f1 — the hash cited by every recorded manifest under paper/results/. Two concrete costs: the 53-entry / 2.8MB evaluation/.cache invalidates so free evals become live Bedrock calls, and recorded results stop matching HEAD (the numbers stay valid, but reproducing them needs a git checkout of the recording commit). Re-recording the detector arms alone is ~315K Opus tokens, about 12% of a daily quota. Repairing a comment is not worth that.
detector_docstring_is_stale.when_to_fix: The next window that busts the hash anyway — Task 6's full-document re-record. Apply the queue, re-run, and record the NEW hash; do not carry 288c64f1 forward, and update RUN_TAG/STATS_TAG plus SUPERSEDED_TAGS in paper/analysis/generate_tables.py at the same time.

caveats: CORPUS TIER: _only_subset, 8-15pp. Nothing here speaks to full documents; that is Task 6.
THE CONFIDENCE RESULT IS A NEGATIVE ONE AND MUST BE PRESENTED AS SUCH. Any sentence implying the model knows when it is uncertain is unsupported by this data.
DO NOT PROMOTE THE 0.90 SEPARATION TO A THRESHOLD. See the_hallucination_threshold_trap — one positive case, and the prompt's own boundary catches nothing.
89.7% AT 0.95+ IS NOT A QUALITY NUMBER. It measures how the model was asked to fill in a field. Reporting it without the degeneracy of the distribution beside it would mislead.

THE VERDICT JOIN IS DIRECT-PATH ONLY. The false-positive audit was performed against the frozen eval detections; there is no audited batched-path population, so no verdict statistic can be quoted for production output.

distinct_domains/strands/sub_strands COUNT PARSED ANCESTORS, not detected elements, and are legitimately smaller (37 vs 52 strands). Do not cross-reference them against the detector table's counts without saying which is which.

AGE-BAND COVERAGE OF 1.000 IS SCHEMA COMPLETENESS, NOT DOCUMENT RICHNESS. Most documents state their range once in prose and the canonicalizers propagate it; it does not mean each standard printed its own band.

n=14 STABILITY SAMPLES ARE NOT EVENLY DISTRIBUTED. AZ and CA have 3 each, the other four have 2 (Task 3's sweep was cut short by an Opus throttle). The probe establishes that no correct element drops below 0.90 in any sample; it does not characterise a per-state spread.

THE MEDIUM ARTICLES REMAIN UNCORRECTED. This task adjudicates their claims for the paper's benefit; it does not edit documentation/medium-articles/, which are prose seed and outside this task's scope.
